basic_info.description: Welcome to 277 Monterey Blvd, a stunning blend of luxury, design, and incredible views. This move-in-ready 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home, built in 2018, spans two spacious levels, offering panoramic views throughout. As you enter, you will discover an open-concept living and dining area that seamlessly flows into a fully equipped chef's kitchen, perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. The main level also includes a generously sized bedroom, a full bath, and a private deck with breathtaking views of San Francisco. The second level of this residence, where the primary suite resides, offers a serene retreat with a walk-in closet and a luxurious en-suite bath. Two additional large bedrooms and a second full bathroom provide ample space for family, guests, or a home office. The property also includes one garage parking spot with EV charging capability and is perfectly situated across from the iconic Sunnyside Conservatory, just moments from neighborhood amenities and BART. With easy access to both the Peninsula and East Bay, this home offers the ultimate convenience for commuters. Experience San Francisco living at 277 Monterey Blvd. Your dream home awaits!
